summary: Minimal, targeted fix that suppresses the spurious 'return type' entry specifically for objtype=='class', which is exactly where the incorrect __init__ return annotation was leaking into autoclass docs; no regression risk since __init__ return annotations are meaningless for class docs.

issues.description: Uses a bare string literal 'class' instead of a shared constant, consistent with existing style in this function but could be seen as a minor nit.
